_about: PLACEHOLDER lines for the Spillway and the jammer works (M4-1), in the grim-world, loud-heroes tone (docs/tone_guide.md). The formal dialogue sign-off is M6-2 and needs Ross. LOCKED, do not reword: the plaque ('Raised so we can hear them') and the mural description (a crew of five waving from a ship heading down the last lane, every window behind them lit). Extra rule: the old Zero's story line about the call and Kasp's loudspeaker lines belong to the Writer; the scene lines here only hold their place. Crowd Zeroes and gate grunts speak as crowd_* ids (plain box).

works_rd_crate_1.speaker: narrator
works_rd_crate_1.text: (The delivery crate in Red's arms thumps. Twice. Then a third time, louder.)

works_rd_crate_1.speaker: otis
works_rd_crate_1.text: That's not a normal crate noise, friend.

works_rd_crate_2.speaker: mox
works_rd_crate_2.text: MOX WUZ HERE! ...In a crate. For about nine hours. Hi.

works_rd_crate_2.speaker: otis
works_rd_crate_2.text: Mox? Little one, this road is not a place for you.

works_rd_crate_2.speaker: mox
works_rd_crate_2.text: A bad road? I LOVE a bad road. ...Okay. Okay! Going home. Going, going.

works_rd_mox_after.speaker: mox
works_rd_mox_after.text: I'm going. Look at me going.

works_rd_tram_sign.speaker: sign
works_rd_tram_sign.text:
LAMP SQUARE · RELAY.
Last stop: nobody remembers. Fares abolished.

works_rd_gauge.speaker: sign
works_rd_gauge.text:
FLOOD LEVEL.
The marks are in years, not feet. The highest is the year the Signals came.

works_rd_grate.speaker: narrator
works_rd_grate.text: Through the grate overhead: boots, and a broadcast. 'A QUIET MOON IS A SAFE MOON.' The boots keep walking.

works_fo_sitin_1.speaker: narrator
works_fo_sitin_1.text: (A row of Zeroes sits on cushions in front of the gate, sleeve bells in their laps. Red sets the thermos down in front of the old one, and the confiscated bells go back on sleeves, one by one.)

works_fo_sitin_1.speaker: narrator
works_fo_sitin_1.text: (Every bell rings at once. A loudspeaker on the fence coughs.)

works_fo_sitin_1.speaker: kasp
works_fo_sitin_1.text: MEMO. Effective immediately, bells are a noise. Disperse. ...Or don't. I have a quota and a very big walker.

works_fo_sitin_1.speaker: narrator
works_fo_sitin_1.text: (A gray Signals crate beside the gate thumps. A lid pops.)

works_fo_sitin_2.speaker: mox
works_fo_sitin_2.text: Told you I'd get here first! MOX WUZ HERE, again, in a better crate.

works_fo_sitin_2.speaker: zero_old
works_fo_sitin_2.text: The drain grate's loose. It's the back way in. Whose turn is it to lift?

works_fo_sitin_2.speaker: narrator
works_fo_sitin_2.text: (The Zeroes put their shoulders to the grate. It comes up with a groan like a very old door.)

works_fo_zero_wait.speaker: zero_old
works_fo_zero_wait.text: Sit. Ring. Repeat. It's the only protest they haven't banned yet.

works_fo_zero_napkin.speaker: zero_old
works_fo_zero_napkin.text: You're going up the old mast? Take this. The tune for the shrine bells, on a napkin.

works_fo_zero_napkin.speaker: zero_old
works_fo_zero_napkin.text: Ring it right and the floor gives up something of ours. ...Don't tell the Sergeant.

works_fo_zero_again.speaker: zero_old
works_fo_zero_again.text: Ring them loud, kid. They were ours before they were his.

works_fo_crowd_a.speaker: crowd_zero
works_fo_crowd_a.text: They took my bell for a noise. My bell! It barely even rings.

works_fo_crowd_b.speaker: crowd_zero
works_fo_crowd_b.text: Quiet's been the law for ten years. We're a little late for the protest. We're here anyway.

works_fo_crowd_c.speaker: crowd_zero
works_fo_crowd_c.text: Don't mind us. We've been sitting since the curfew. We'll sit through the next one.

works_fo_grunt_a.speaker: crowd_grunt
works_fo_grunt_a.text: Please. Please stop ringing. I have a headache that has a headache.

works_fo_grunt_b.speaker: crowd_grunt
works_fo_grunt_b.text: I'm only here till my shift ends. ...Which is never. Is it never? Nobody tells me.

works_fo_mox.speaker: mox
works_fo_mox.text: In a crate. Again. Very cozy.

works_fo_gate.speaker: sign
works_fo_gate.text:
SIGNALS ACCESS ONLY.
And the Signals don't like you.

works_ts_enter.speaker: otis
works_ts_enter.text: Hush a moment. Old stone. ...It feels like a church that got taken over by an office.

works_ts_enter.speaker: mox
works_ts_enter.text: An office with a conveyor belt. I can hear it through the ceiling. It sounds like a very long meeting.

works_ts_plaque.speaker: sign
works_ts_plaque.text: RAISED SO WE CAN HEAR THEM.

works_ts_mural.speaker: narrator
works_ts_mural.text: A faded mural: a crew of five waving from a ship, heading down the last lane. Every window behind them is lit.

works_tc_chart.speaker: sign
works_tc_chart.text:
QUOTA: 400. ACHIEVED: 1,203.
- Sgt. Kasp: NOT ENOUGH.

works_tc_spool.speaker: sign
works_tc_spool.text: PROPERTY OF SGT. KASP. DO NOT TOUCH. THIS MEANS YOU.

works_tc_conveyor.speaker: narrator
works_tc_conveyor.text: The conveyor never stops. Not for lunch. Especially not for lunch.

works_tb_window.speaker: narrator
works_tb_window.text: Through the slit: the slums' neon, and past it, Harrow's windows. Fewer lit than there used to be.

works_tg_rubble.speaker: narrator
works_tg_rubble.text: The stairs are gone. Cable everywhere. Very Kasp.

works_tg_plate.speaker: sign
works_tg_plate.text:
MAKER'S PLATE.
The date's been worn off by hands, not years.

works_tg_board.speaker: sign
works_tg_board.text: INSPECTED. The sticker is dated last week. Initials: S.K.

works_td_console.speaker: sign
works_td_console.text:
SPEC SHEET: THE HUSHMASTER.
Written, drawn and underlined by Sgt. Kasp. Margin note: 'MORE CUPHOLDERS.'

works_td_line.speaker: narrator
works_td_line.text: Every drone's serial plate reads: BUILT FOR A QUIETER HARROW.

works_td_coffee.speaker: sign
works_td_coffee.text: COFFEE STATION. DECAF ONLY, BY ORDER.

works_tl_rack.speaker: narrator
works_tl_rack.text: Kasp's coat rack, with a lanyard of about forty laminated cards. Every one is his photo.

works_tl_zero_pour.speaker: zero_old
works_tl_zero_pour.text: Somebody had to come up the back way.

works_tl_zero_pour.speaker: narrator
works_tl_zero_pour.text: (She pours from the thermos Red delivered. It's hot. It's the best thing anyone has tasted in years.)

works_tl_zero_pour.speaker: zero_old
works_tl_zero_pour.text: Drink. All of you. Then go be loud.

works_tl_zero_luck.speaker: zero_old
works_tl_zero_luck.text: Go loud, kid. I'll keep the lamp warm.
